summary.answer: Frontend XP wrapper directly constructs this horizontal list. Weapon XP requires current playlist double weapon XP; tier boost uses current lobby tier boost. lobbyNav/playlistId/AutoEvents.cycled callbacks reevaluate XP and weapon icons; lobbyMainMode reevaluates tier icon. A ZMDoubleNP child is constructed independently; its own predicate is preserved under unit201. No reward grant or account operation.
